items.summary: DialogflowFeaturegemini-3.5-flash-lite has become generally available (GA). SeeGenerative quotasfor how to request quota for Gemini 3 and later models.Gemini EnterpriseFeatureGemini Enterprise: Connect workflows in Workflow Builder toConfluence Data Center and Jira Data CenterYou can connect workflows in Workflow Builder to Confluence Data Center andJira Data Center to search data and automate actions across these third-partyapps.For more information, see Workflowsoverview.Vertex AI SearchChangeAgent Search: Update to the stable modelThe stable model for answer generation is updated togemini-3.5-flash/answer_gen/v1 from gemini-2.5-flash/answer_gen/v1.For more information, see Answer generation model versions andlifecycle.
